principles: One shared helper owns runtimeMode classification for check and doctor.
Plain text output answers the user question before verbose diagnostics.
runtimeMode is local diagnostic truth only, not authority evidence.
Safe sync mutation behavior remains conservative and covered by smoke tests.
drivers: Koala Mac B-3e9a depends on stable JSON and plain text behavior from core CLI.
Existing runtime facts are low-level and need a product-facing summary.
Core story must remain independent of external wrapper proof while providing a concrete handoff surface.

options.name: shared-runtimeMode-helper
pros: Single schema and classification path for check and doctor
Easy to test in one smoke file
cons: Requires small type/interface changes in runtime checks and handlers

options.name: handler-local-runtimeMode
cons: Check and doctor can drift in schema or wording

options.name: doctor-only-summary
cons: Does not satisfy check --json contract or managed asset UX

rationale: A shared helper is the only option that keeps JSON schema, text summary, and Koala Mac wrapper proof aligned across check and doctor.

preMortem.scenario: runtimeMode schema differs between check and doctor
preMortem.trigger: Each handler builds its own object
preMortem.consequence: Koala Mac wrapper proof passes one command and fails the other
preMortem.mitigation: Export one build/render helper from runtime-environment-checks and use it in both handlers.

preMortem.trigger: Doctor appends summary after health issues
preMortem.consequence: User still cannot tell whether JS runtime is required
preMortem.mitigation: Render runtime footprint summary before health details in doctor and before drift details in check.

preMortem.scenario: Unsafe managed asset drift gets overwritten
preMortem.mitigation: Keep applyDefinition status guard and add smoke coverage for refused unsafe statuses.

preMortem.scenario: runtime diagnostics are mistaken for production authority
preMortem.consequence: Local wrapper state appears to prove DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Use fixed authority string local-runtime-diagnostic-only and explicit non-authority note.
